title: The Rename button you didn't approve — and what should replace it

steps.path: Click the session name at the top → Sessions in this window
steps.headline: The bare Rename button is gone from the session list.
steps.changed: A previous round added a plain Rename button to the right of every row. It was never on a deck and you never approved it. It has been taken out.
steps.measured: 1 button per row removed, 9 rows in this list
steps.notice: Right-click a session and Rename session… is still there — that one you did approve. Nothing else about the list moved.
steps.risk: Until you pick something below, the only way to rename from this list is the right-click menu, which is not visible until you try it.

steps.path: Resume Session → the saved conversation list
steps.headline: The conversation name lines up with the folder underneath it.
steps.changed: The name was sitting eight pixels right of everything else in its card, because the clickable area around it was padded. The padding is still there for the hover highlight; the text starts where the folder line starts.
steps.notice: The left edge of every card now reads as one straight line down the list.
steps.risk: None found. The hover highlight is unchanged and still has room around the text.

steps.path: Click the session name at the top → Sessions in this window
steps.headline: Should the session list offer renaming at all, and if so how?
steps.notice: Whatever you pick here only affects this list. The right-click Rename session… stays either way, and Resume Session keeps the pencil and underline you already approved.
steps.risk: The rows in this list are small and already carry a status pill, a folder, a model name and tag marks. Anything added competes with them.

variants.label: Nothing here
variants.summary: Renaming stays on the right-click menu only. The list keeps every pixel for the things that tell sessions apart.
variants.risk: A right-click menu is invisible until you try it. Someone who never right-clicks never finds renaming here.

variants.label: Pencil only
variants.summary: The same pencil as Resume Session, right after each name. Clicking the pencil renames; clicking anywhere else on the row still switches to that session.
variants.measured: 12 px wide, the same pencil as the saved list
variants.risk: Without the underline it does not match Resume Session exactly.

variants.label: Pencil and dotted underline
variants.summary: The full Resume Session treatment: dotted underline under the name and the pencil beside it, both always visible. The whole name renames.
variants.risk: Clicking the name no longer switches sessions — it renames. The name is the most natural thing to click to switch, so you would have to aim beside it.
